sizeReason: The final 22 entries complete the 27-entry Events dictionary; its five birth messages were reviewed jointly with Lexicon in batch18.

review.notes: All 22 source/Greek pairs read in full. Baby naming uses neuter agreement with αγόρι/κορίτσι and μωρό; adoption stays distinct from biological birth. Native QuestionEvent provides raw animal display type, so it remains an unchanged category label in parentheses. Comet lines reviewed in native MaruComet sequence; impersonal beauty/emptiness wording avoids assigning a wrong grammatical referent. Night Market matches glossary. Three authored novel titles retain genre-appropriate meanings and the invented Yazzo name by Greek transliteration.
